question: How did the monthly average real-time price at the ERCOT hub average move through 2022, and which month was highest?
answer:
July 2022 was the highest month. The hub average's monthly mean of the fifteen-minute real-time prices was 141.2 USD/MWh in July (ercot_all_hub_prices_history). Months are local America/Chicago, and the whole-year mean was 62.3 USD/MWh (ercot_all_hub_prices_history).

Through the year, the monthly mean:
- Started low at 29.1 in January, then 46.4 in February and 32.1 in March.
- Rose to 48.7 in April and 88.2 in May.
- Dipped to 64.9 in June before the July peak.
- Fell back to 88.6 in August and 64.3 in September.
- Ended at 48.4 in October, 40.3 in November (the low of the second half) and 52.8 in December.

The lowest month was January, at 29.1.
